The close is unconditional for redirects: `sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false)`. There is no check that the panel is in overlay mode, so a docked wide-screen panel would be closed too.

The Dashboard case (`urls.dashboard(resourceId)`) and Survey case (`urls.survey(resourceId)`) are unchanged. The patch adds no parameters to any transfer URL.

result:
I made all three changes, but I haven't run the typecheck, lint or any tests, so none of it is verified. The transfer page's Back link and the subscriptions empty state also haven't been checked in a browser or Storybook.

- **Duplicate on a narrow screen:** in `frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightLogic.tsx`, the duplicate listener now closes the actions sidebar after it opens the new copy. It only does this when the duplicate redirects to the new insight, which is what the sidebar button does.
- **Transfer page Back link:** the transfer URL carries the insight's numeric ID, and there is no route that opens an insight by that ID.
  - `resourceTransferLogic.ts` now looks up the insight's short ID for insight transfers. It adds a `sourceInsightShortId` loader that calls `insightsApi.getByNumericId` when the logic mounts.
  - `ResourceTransfer.tsx` builds Back with `urls.insightView(shortId)`. While the short ID is loading, or if the lookup fails, Back goes to the saved insights list instead of a broken link.
  - I added the new loader to the hand-written type block in the logic file by hand, since I didn't regenerate types.
- **Subscriptions empty state:** in `SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx`, the featured `SubscriptionEmptyState` card is now a container-query container. Below the `@sm` container breakpoint the illustration is hidden. Wider than that it sits beside the text as before, and the layout stacks in a column when narrow.

Hiding the illustration was my reading of "no longer sit beside the text". If you would rather see it stacked above the text, change `hidden @sm:block` on the illustration wrapper to plain `block`.
